description: Source code for MAC filtering management in a Wi-Fi access point, including functions for synchronizing MAC filter lists, handling timer callbacks, and managing entries in the MAC filtering and probe filtering lists.

methods.name: s_mfSyncTimer_cb
methods.description: Callback for MF synchronization timer, executes either address list sync or MAC filter update based on flag.

methods.name: s_startMfSyncTimer
methods.description: Starts or restarts the MF sync timer with specified sync mode.

methods.name: s_stopMfSyncTimer
methods.description: Stops and deletes the MF sync timer.

methods.name: delay_WPS_disable
methods.description: Delays disabling WPS and updates its state.

methods.name: sync_changes
methods.description: Synchronizes MAC address lists between internal data and external object, detects changes.

methods.name: s_updateMACFilterAddressList
methods.description: Updates the MAC filter address list string based on current entries.

methods.name: s_syncMACFiltering
methods.description: Synchronizes MAC filtering list for an access point object, updates mode, WPS, and entries.

methods.name: s_syncProbeFiltering
methods.description: Synchronizes probe filtering list for an access point object.

methods.name: s_setMfConf_ocf
methods.description: Callback to set MAC filtering configuration.

methods.name: s_deleteAllEntries
methods.description: Deletes all entries in a specified list for an access point.

methods.name: s_addEntryObject
methods.description: Creates a new MAC filtering or probe filtering entry object.

methods.name: s_fetchEntryExt
methods.description: Fetches a specific entry object by MAC address, optionally excluding a specific object.

methods.name: s_fetchEntry
methods.description: Fetches a MAC filtering or probe filtering entry object by MAC address.

methods.name: s_doesEntryExist
methods.description: Checks if a specific MAC address entry exists.

methods.name: s_deleteUnusedEntries
methods.description: Deletes entries not present in the current address list.

methods.name: s_syncAddressList
methods.description: Synchronizes the address list with the internal MAC filtering entries.

methods.name: s_cleanupMACFilterAddressList
methods.description: Cleans up MAC filter address list and stops sync timer.

methods.name: _wld_ap_validateMfMac_pvf
methods.description: Validates MAC address for MAC filtering list, checks for duplicates and max entries.

methods.name: _wld_ap_validateAddressList_pvf
methods.description: Validates address list string for correct MAC address format.

methods.name: wld_apMacFilter_setAddressList_pwf
methods.description: Sets the MAC filter address list, triggers sync timer.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a MAC address entry to the specified list.

methods.name: delEntry
methods.description: Deletes a MAC address entry from the specified list.

methods.name: _MACFiltering_addEntry
methods.description: API to add a MAC filtering entry.

methods.name: _MACFiltering_addTempEntry
methods.description: API to add a temporary MAC filtering entry.

methods.name: _MACFiltering_delEntry
methods.description: API to delete a MAC filtering entry.

methods.name: _MACFiltering_delTempEntry
methods.description: API to delete a temporary MAC filtering entry.

methods.name: _ProbeFiltering_addTempEntry
methods.description: API to add a probe filtering temporary entry.

methods.name: _ProbeFiltering_delTempEntry
methods.description: API to delete a probe filtering temporary entry.

methods.name: wld_apMacFilter_getBanList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of MAC addresses to ban or kick based on filtering mode.
